fields.Fee estimate basis:
MBA [NCR-155]: ESTIMATE — constant-price two-year academic reference, not an official total or all-in budget. Published first-year/annual amount ₹393,800; annual tuition ₹2,71,400 (₹1,35,700 × two instalments). Low ₹665,200 = full first-year amount plus second-year tuition only, so it is a component floor. High ₹784,600 = twice annual amount less known ₹3,000 one-time alumni membership. This only varies recurrence of non-tuition components; it does not bound future fee rises. Hostel, transport, future revisions and unlisted charges excluded. Source cycle: 2026–27.
Conditional fee low ₹L: 6.652; Conditional fee high ₹L: 7.846

MBA (Business Intelligence & Analytics) [NCR-199]: ESTIMATE — constant-price two-year academic reference, not an official total or all-in budget. Published first-year/annual amount ₹446,800; annual tuition ₹2,71,400 (₹1,35,700 × two instalments). Low ₹718,200 = full first-year amount plus second-year tuition only, so it is a component floor. High ₹890,600 = twice annual amount less known ₹3,000 one-time alumni membership. This only varies recurrence of non-tuition components; it does not bound future fee rises. Hostel, transport, future revisions and unlisted charges excluded. Source cycle: 2026–27.
Conditional fee low ₹L: 7.182; Conditional fee high ₹L: 8.906

MBA Global (Dual Degree) with KEDGE Business School, France — 1+1 pathway [NCR-200]: n.a. — no defensible all-in two-year estimate. Official MRIIRS 2026–27 annual India-side fee is ₹5,24,800, including pathway components, but the dual degree depends on foreign partner, study location, overseas tuition and living costs. Repeating this annual amount would not establish the full programme cost. Obtain a partner-specific written fee schedule.
